responsibility: Defines the core target macros, ABI constants, storage layout, register set, assembler syntax, and miscellaneous backend policies for the VAX port. It establishes CPU builtins, default target flags and libraries, endianness and alignment rules, hard-register numbering and fixed/call-used masks, stack/frame/static-chain conventions, assembler directives and register names, operand-printing hooks, jump-table emission, and target properties such as CTZ behavior, serving as the central configuration header consumed by the rest of the VAX backend.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-name VAX files, this is the central configuration header of target macros and constants: register numbers/names, ABI/layout macros, assembler syntax, and default specs. It defines compile-time interface data used by the backend, rather than implementing hook code like vax.cc, instruction patterns like vax.md, or command-line options like vax.opt.
